name: idbTwoTabsFreshIds
covers: part (iv): two tabs of one IndexedDB profile, each with a fresh page id, commit and collect against each other
redSeedsReason: The interleaving is the seed's alone: only on seed 1 does the second tab's commit meet the first tab's commit-key write between its read and its write. On seeds 2 to 4 the tabs commit one after the other, so a commit that skips the compare overwrites nothing.
